column1: # Security advisory floors for the native components shipped under resources/.
# Floors come from primary advisories (NVD, GitHub Security Advisories, upstream
# security pages, OSV) checked on 2026-09-25 against the versions physically shipped.
# The inventory gate refuses any shipped version of a component below a floor.
# A floor is never lowered without a written exemption.
# floor is the first fixed release. When it lists several comma-separated versions,
# each applies to its own release branch (same major.minor); a version on no listed
# branch is held to the lowest listed floor.
# A row with floor "-" and advisory "none" records a component audited clean.
# Floor "-" with any other advisory records that the vulnerable part does not ship.
# Floor "absent:<v>" records a removed component: the gate fails if it is shipped
# again, and <v> is the floor to restore.
# Reachability is recorded in the disposition; it never exempts a row.

the CVE fix is applied in the shipped build: LibreOffice 26.2.6 builds raptor2.dll from 2.0.16 with external/redland/raptor/raptor-backport-unreleased-fixes.patch.1 (raptor_ntriples.c bnode bound, position > 0), all platforms, per UnpackedTarball_raptor.mk at tag libreoffice-26-2-6. An un-numbered underread remains in the same N-Triples term parser (a malformed \u escape reads one byte before the buffer; upstream raptor 701621c98cc3, 2026-07-11, not carried by LibreOffice). Not reachable: raptor_ntriples_parse_term is called only by the ntriples/nquads parsers and by raptor_new_term_from_counted_string, whose one caller in the tree is rasqal's CSV/TSV query-results reader (rasqal_format_sv.c); LibreOffice creates its only parser as librdf_new_parser(world, "rdfxml") in unoxml librdf_repository.cxx (ODF manifest.rdf and metadata import), runs SPARQL against the in-memory model and never reads a results file; "rdfxml" is the only raptor syntax name in mergedlo.dll. No fixed upstream release; floor was 2.0.17
